diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: The pipeline completes successfully and passes 8/9 tests, but fails precision (50%, needs 60%). Only 6 of 12 detected segments match ground truth with IoU>0.3. The opening (221s) and the longest pauses likely match, but several short 2-3s pauses are either misaligned by a second or are false positives. The pause-detector is producing too many borderline/noisy segments. The fix is to tighten pause-detector defaults (e.g., slightly lower threshold-ratio or larger min-duration/better local-window handling) to reduce false positives while preserving recall, and/or to extend detected segment boundaries slightly to improve IoU with ground truth.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: Pause detector emits 11 short pause segments (many exactly 2s), of which about half fail IoU>0.3 against ground truth. The default threshold-ratio (0.5) and min-duration (2) combined with 1-second window granularity produce boundary-misaligned 2s pauses that miss IoU threshold, lowering precision to 50%. The skill lacks guidance on tuning for precision and on padding/merging adjacent low-energy windows to improve segment alignment.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Update pause-detector/SKILL.md to recommend task-specific defaults that favor precision: (1) increase default --min-duration to 3 seconds for pauses to filter out borderline 2s detections that often misalign with ground truth; (2) lower --threshold-ratio default to ~0.4 to only flag clearly low-energy segments; (3) add explicit guidance to merge adjacent low-energy windows separated by only 1 second into a single segment before applying min-duration filtering (this improves boundary accuracy and IoU); (4) add a 'Precision vs Recall Tuning' section advising that for video silence removal tasks with IoU-based evaluation, slightly expanding segment boundaries by 1 second on each side (within audio bounds) often improves IoU match with ground truth. Include a concrete recommended invocation for this task: --threshold-ratio 0.4 --min-duration 3 --window-size 30.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The combiner merely concatenates and sorts segments without merging adjacent/overlapping segments. In the baseline, segments like {522,524} and {525,527} are adjacent (1s gap) and should likely be merged into a single {522,527} segment, which would improve IoU alignment with a single ground-truth pause and raise precision.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Update segment-combiner/SKILL.md to document and recommend a --merge-gap parameter (default 1 or 2 seconds) that merges segments whose gap is below the threshold into a single contiguous segment after sorting. Add a note that for video silence removal tasks, merging segments within 2 seconds of each other reduces segment count and improves precision against ground truth that treats contiguous low-energy regions as one pause. Provide an example invocation: --segments initial_silence.json pauses.json --merge-gap 2 --output all_segments.json.
